note: the mask feather uses sigma = radius instead of radius / 3, so the edge fades three times too far and the first pixel inside reads well under 0.6, caught by MaskOpsTests.edgeIsHalfAtTheEdge
the mask feather's column pass steps its samples along a row instead of down the column, so a tall mask no longer feathers like its transpose, caught by MaskOpsTests.tallMaskFeathersLikeItsTranspose
the Gaussian kernel checks only sigma 0, so a feather radius whose 2 sigma squared underflows divides by 0 and returns a NaN mask, caught by MaskOpsTests.underflowingRadiusKeepsTheMask
the extended box's end weight uses t instead of 3 t, so the passes' variance misses sigma squared, caught by MaskFeatherBoxTests.extendedBoxMatchesTheVariance
the mask feather takes the boxes at every sigma, so a small radius drifts far from its Gaussian, caught by MaskFeatherBoxTests.boxFeatherStaysNearTheGaussian
